_about: Resurrection settings per party (dashboard -> party card -> Settings -> Resurrection). Missing party / key = the "default" entry, then the built-in defaults: auto true (dead teammates are resurrected by themselves), scrolls true, raidHealerScrolls true (owner 2026-10-13: a dead healer may be scrolled in a raid), raidAllScrolls false (no scrolls on others in a raid), scrollWho anyone | nottank | names (+ scrollNames), maxWalk 6000 (how far a resser walks to a body), blessedFirst false. Your orders (!res, !resall, the Resurrect button) always work. Read live by swarm.js every 5 s.
